capture_motion_policy.policy_note: The initial knife-handle landmark uses the existing timestamp-coherent capture policy. Live trials must confirm visibility, depth stability, timing margin, and motion bounds.

landmark_fallback_policy.no_hardware_modification_strategy: Use the existing military-green knife handle and its two visible longitudinal endpoints without adding a fiducial.
landmark_fallback_policy.optional_physical_fiducial_policy: Any future fiducial requires a separately revised mounted-effector profile and must not silently replace the handle landmark.

visual_alignment_landmarks.description_for_vlm: Locate only the military-green handle clamped by the two black gripper fingers. The attached tool body is context only: do not classify it as a knife, blade, spatula, scraper, or any other object, and do not reject the scene because of its apparent type, material, color, or shape. Annotate exactly two physical features on the green handle: knife_handle_blade_junction is the center of the handle end adjoining the attached non-green tool body, and knife_handle_rear_endpoint is the center of the opposite longitudinal handle end. Select both RGB points on visible military-green handle surface, slightly inside its silhouette, then independently select valid registered-depth pixels on the same physical green handle surface. Do not select either black gripper finger, any part of the attached tool body, an edge shared with the background, a highlight, the background, or another object. Reject the scene only when one or both required handle features cannot be located on the green handle or cannot be registered to valid same-surface depth.

tool_point_binding.measurement_note: Initial trial assumption: the vector from the active controlled/IK frame origin to the arithmetic mean of the blade-junction and rear-handle points is [-90, +10, -70] mm in the controlled frame. Reverse both signs if the supplied measurement direction was handle mean to controlled origin.

visibility.material_note: The alignment target is only the military-green handle surface held by the two-finger black grip. The attached tool body is contextual and its visual classification is irrelevant.

reference_image_policy.note: A swappable knife reference image is planned but not yet connected to the production asset resolver. Live RGB-D and this profile description are the current inputs.

invalidation_conditions: Knife handle, blade, adapter, or mount geometry changes
The trial controlled-frame-to-handle-mean vector is revised
The active mounted-effector identity, revision, or assembly fingerprint changes
Measured mass or center of mass differs from the provisional inertial values
Knife, adapter, or mount replacement or remount
Robot model or terminal-frame revision change
Controlled point or cutting edge is registered to a different frame
Temporary gripper collision spheres are replaced by measured blade geometry
A held or attached object is not declared as runtime attachment state
